{{Otheruses|Epsilon}}
'''Epsilon Garrison''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The city was a major [[Army/Legends|military]] base. Much of the surrounding land was devoted to [[Farm/Legends|farming]], with the food intended for garrisoned [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city, [[Fort Maximus]].<ref name="UR ">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
